items.note: States h=100, N=v^3, m=h^3, the signed exchange (X,Y)->(-Y,X) with restored scratch, and derives it as in the paper: scratch-independent net change (JV+RG)x, central coefficients |S∩T| mod 2 and (|S∩T|-1)/2 cancelled by side injection, then the three-stage shear composition; I, W_b, W_c match lines 776-781. The gate maps themselves are not spelled out, but the paper's proof steps are all present.

Frames D_v per vertex, edge change D_vD_u^{-1}, invariant via R-linearity at a gate, implemented operator D_out S_Omega D_in^{-1} and route operator eps_w D_sink(rho(w)) D_source(w)^{-1} for all roles, exactly the paper's argument.

Gives the form with <t_S,t_T>=|S∩T|-1, terminal labels, stage transitions, the full residual table, the single decreasing edge (center 3->4, loss h), telescoping to Wm-2N+2L with L=Ich, and the ratios 100/539, 101/539. The per-time gate-label table and the proof that binary residuals have orthonormal bases are only stated, not argued.

Projections P_U on gates/sinks, -P_{U_a} on X_a sources, rank(P_V-P_U)=dim V-dim U, the first edge 2P_{U_a} adding N ranks, endpoint difference I_m on every role, Phi_M frames giving H<-H+D on every role, and s_b=W_b m-N+2L_b<W_b m: the paper's proof.

Phase frames C_U, mod-4 weight additivity over an orthonormal residual basis, odd weights giving aI+bX_v or its inverse after Hadamard conjugation, s_c=W_c m-2N+2L_c, the Z corrections on the 27 support coordinates, and k columns by tensoring all follow lines 1231-1315.
L/N<1/2 gives deficits N-2L_b and 2N-2L_c; eta_b, eta_c exact values; both exceed 20*2^{-50}; log m<20 gives m^{1-2^{-50}}>m(1-eta), hence s/W<m^tau with tau=sigma=1-2^{-50}, as in lines 1319-1346.

The elementary stream operations and the controlled shift (split at Q-a, offset work absorbed by b^C=O(Q)) follow the paper. Multiplication by a fixed rational unit is claimed, but the method covers only an integer c prime to q; the inverse multiplication and the negation (lines 603-614) that make up a signed rational unit are missing.

Pivot elimination (topmost row, rightmost entry) giving A=E_1 Pi E_2 with a ones; a fixed odd prime avoiding denominators and diagonal numerators; triangular transforms in O(V); each one of Pi done by D_j+=H_i, swap, D_j=H_i-D_j with one interchange: the paper's proof.

Cyclic role-stream split to V/W, Phi_M frames with edges done by rank-many recursive interchanges, shear H<-H+D on every row, the three-shear interchange, the recurrence F_k<=(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1) solved to O(e^tau), and the fixed-tape depth-first schedule and descriptor bound are all reproduced.

High digits form a row field of range q^{2rho}>=W^k, zero rows padded to a multiple of W^k, base-m pieces summing to O(Ve^tau), binary-to-radix-q padding, and the unequal-width variant all match the paper's proof.

Basic identities H_0=bSCS and C^{-1}=-iZCZ, conjugation by P_M moving the residual basis to coordinate slots, one forward child per inverse kernel, exactly s_c children on f=e/m axes, a fixed number of row additions, and H_0^{⊗D}=b^D S_D C^{⊗D} S_D.

Eight parity-controlled additions giving (00 10)(01 11), K-bit segments with guards in [10,2^{K-1}-11], delta_bad=min{1,80(f-1)2^{-K}}, T_0 S_0^{-1} permuting only B, repair by radix sort, and the cost bound all follow the proof.

Individual kernels O(Ve), node overhead O(V((eK)^tau+1)), q_0 row chunks padded to a multiple of W^{k_0}, the recurrence F(e)<=(s/W)F(e/m)+O((eK)^tau+1), internal-node and leaf sums, and the base-m partition giving O(d^{lambda'}).

States the O(Vd^{lambda'}) layer with one final truncation and error < sqrt2 2^{-p}; derives the guard width Delta=ceil(C_0 d^{C_1}) from A(e)<=sA(e/m)+E with nu=11, C_1=20. The proof's check that the bands make every packed call uniform (A_*<=C_A p, K>=6, K/log p->inf) is only implicit in S2.2.8.

Character cancellation by pairing, decimation in frequency with bit-reversed storage, the reversed procedure giving F^+B^{-1}, the layout L by prefix-slot moves and width-K chunk exchanges, truncation commuting with J_E, error sqrt2 l 2^{-p}, and the cost O(Tp[dK+pK^{tau-1}+l d^{lambda'}]).

Evaluation at B_0=2^{4p}, four products by the established multiplier, separation |h_j|<=r2^{2p}<B_0/2, carry-based packing and centered extraction, negacyclic reduction, and the final shift by p+l bits: the paper's proof.

Two forward transforms kept in LB order, pointwise products, the opposite transform, exact scaling by M; normalization via F^-(f*g)=M(F^-f)(F^-g); error 2delta, +eta, 3delta+eta, times M; cost including O(Tp log(rp)).

N=CTD inverted by Neumann series from the quoted HvdH estimate, contractions A=S/2 and B_0=D'J'C with product of normalizations 2^{-2alpha^2}, ordered numerical maps with errors 16p, 3p^2/4, 4, tensoring with gamma=2d alpha^2, line costs and axis exposure O(Tp d^2(1+l^tau)).

Periodicity of the chirp (t_i even), coefficient (1/T)exp(2pi i sum s_i j_i k_i/t_i) matching QF_t, F_q^+R_c=R_c^{-1}F_q^+ giving RF_s^+R=F_s^+, the convolution rule giving (u*v)/S^2, and conjugation for RF_s^+.

All fixed rationals, the size parameters and Theta-relations, comparison constants, alpha, gamma<28b^{2/3}, the Rosser-Schoenfeld prime count, T/2<S<T by Bernoulli, alpha^4 theta_i>p, the n^{o(1)} prime search, no wraparound and c_j<2^{3b} are all reproduced.

Isomorphism via the order-S image of x, the triangular mixed-radix formula, zero padding, updates in order i=d..1 as prefix-controlled cyclic shifts preserving padding, and O(d^2) axis interchanges for O(Tp d^2(1+l^tau)).

Source transform A~, chirp transform C~ (twisted ring convolution), B~_0, scale 2^gamma with exact counterpart RF_s, F~^+ by conjugation, and the six steps: digits scaled by 2^{-b-2}, Phi, two transforms, product, F~^+, scales S and 2^{2b+4}S, rounding, Phi^{-1}, carries.

Error chain E_ring<5TL, 6TL, 8TL, E_s=9*2^gamma TL, (2E_s+2), (3E_s+2), E_w<28*2^gamma T^2 L with disk margins, final error 448b2^{-3b/4}<1/2 using gamma<=b/4, rounding, and radix-2^b carries with the k_j bound.

All nine table rows with their powers of p, the seven margins with min g_2=2^{-181}=2kappa, the per-row justifications, setup and exceptional-stream costs o(V), log-power absorption, and the schoolbook cutoff.

S0 asserts that the bound disproves the n log n conjecture in this model, but no step states the eventual lower bound T_A(n)>=c_A n lg n, its negation via liminf, or why O(n(lg n)^{1-kappa}) gives limit zero.

errors.says: A fixed binary change of basis is a fixed number of row additions, each applied to all slots' selected bits together.
errors.paper: One row addition adds slot h' to slot h, XORing x_{h,j} <- x_{h,j} xor x_{h',j} for every column j in one packed call, with a third slot as restored scratch. It touches two slots, not all slots.

chain: The tree follows the paper's route from start to finish. It builds the fixed bank-exchange network, frames, labels, rank budget and exponent, then the interchange recurrence and the arbitrary-width interchange. The complex phase interface, packed additions and layer recurrence give the simultaneous layer, which feeds synthetic transforms, ring convolution, resampling with retained permutations, chirp cancellation, the six-step algorithm, exact recovery and the cost table with min margin 2kappa. The only thin spots are peripheral: the rational-unit part of the controlled-shift lemma (no inverse or negation), the band-uniformity check inside the layer proof, and the conjecture-negation clause, which is only asserted in S0.

steps.note: h=100, v, N=v^3, m=h^3, banks indexed by T^3, and the fixed three-stage network sending (X_a,Y_a)->(-Y_a,X_a) while restoring every scratch wire are all stated.
A common invertible frame commutes with the pointwise gate, the network implements D_out S_Omega D_in^{-1}, and only the edge changes D_vD_u^{-1} cost anything.
Nondegenerate subspaces of F^{⊗3} (dim m) as labels, nested along every edge; the only decreasing edges are the central 3->4 edges, each losing h.
S1.5.8 states rank(P_V-P_U)=dim V-dim U and the N source exceptions (first edge 2P_{U_a}, rank one).
Sum of |Delta dim| = Wm-2N+2L with L=Ich, plus the N extra source ranks, giving s_b=W_b m-N+2L_b.
L_b/N=100/539 and L_c/N=101/539, both below 1/2, so the deficits N-2L_b>0 (and 2N-2L_c>0) give s<Wm.
The endpoint difference is I_m on every role, so with Phi_M frames every role array, scratch roles included, receives the shear H<-H+D.
A rank-a shear factors as E_1 Pi E_2 and costs exactly a interchanges plus O(V), so the node makes exactly s recursive calls.
Children of volume V/W give F_k<=(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1); eta>20*2^{-50} and log m<20 give s/W<m^tau with tau=1-2^{-50}; the geometric sum gives F_k=O(e^tau).

central.summary: All nine steps of the central saving are reconstructed with their defining content: the fixed h=100 exchange network, frames, nested labels with the single decreasing central edge, rank equal to dimension change with the N source exceptions, the budget Wm-2N+2L and s_b=W_b m-N+2L_b, the ratios 100/539 and 101/539 giving s<Wm, the endpoint identity I_m producing the shear, rank-many recursive interchanges per edge, and the recurrence with tau=1-2^{-50}.
